artifacts.bundle_name: Blake Neff Tweet – Utah Prosecutors Response

sub_items.description: Blake Neff tweet asserting the Robinson defense is "very conspicuously not contesting any of the core evidence" (camera footage, DNA, rifle, cause of death, phone data) and that the defense "has only a complaint about reliable hearsay."

artifacts.bundle_name: Exclusive Footage – Terryl/Taral SD Card and Laptop Handling

sub_items.description: Video segment showing the camera operator (Taral/Terryl/Terryl) bending over the camera behind Charlie Kirk's head, removing the SD card, pocketing it, looking around, then opening his laptop and apparently inserting the SD card into it. Lane Schamberger is visible at the side washing his hands.
Video segment showing the yellow audience-facing camera falling/knocked to the floor shortly after Charlie is removed from the scene, coming to rest with its encompassed SD card on the ground.
Video segment showing Taral/Terryl stepping over the fallen yellow camera and its encompassed SD card en route to the camera behind Charlie's head.

artifacts.bundle_name: Trump Fox and Friends Audio Clip – Mike Mitchell Recognition

sub_items.description: Audio clip of Donald Trump on Fox and Friends describing the identification chain: "Somebody that's close recognizes even a little tilt of the head… Somebody that was very close to him said, 'Hmm, that's him.'… essentially went to the father, and went to a US Marshal… The person was involved with law enforcement, but was a person of faith, a minister."

Audio clip of streamer Hasan Piker saying: "I can't speak out against this queen because this is a queen that successfully and single-handedly undermined the Republican initiative to martyrize Charlie Kirk… She dropped a grenade on the discourse. So, I'm with her… My brain says, 'No, it's probably Tyler Robinson.' But my heart says, 'Go Candace go.'… Candace Owens blocked me many, many years ago."

artifacts.bundle_name: Blake Neff Tweet – Candace / Hasan Coordination

sub_items.description: Blake Neff tweet: "Hasan is openly celebrating Candace Owens calling her a queen because she single-handedly undermined the effort to martyrize Charlie to go after the violent radical left… The radical pro-violence left knows exactly what a gift Candace and her ilk are to them."

artifacts.bundle_name: Wear Forbidden Video Clip – Matrix Parody

sub_items.description: Video clip from "Wear Forbidden" X/Instagram account using the red-pill/blue-pill Matrix framing to parody reactions to the Tyler Robinson case, repeating "So what?" against "positive evidence," "appeal to emotion," and "burden of proof."

Host-produced on-screen diagram labeling camera positions at the event – "red camera behind his head" and a "yellow" camera that fell – referenced as having been previously shown and re-displayed in this episode.
Host verbal reference to Brandi Zadrozny's article (not shown)

artifacts.bundle_name: Community Note on Blake Neff Tweet Bundle

sub_items.description: Host reads the Community Note attached to Blake Neff's tweet
Host verbal reference to Farnsworth's 1102 statement describing camera coverage and the lengths of the videos he provided (not shown)

artifacts.bundle_name: Erika Kirk Glenn Beck Statement Bundle

sub_items.description: Host verbal reference to Erika Kirk's statement on Glenn Beck's show about Charlie's night-before texts (not played)
Host reads viewer comment saying Terryl Farnsworth could be guilty of evidence tampering and obstruction
Host reads viewer comment saying a downward-pointing camera would show the men handling Charlie
Host reads viewer comment asking whether Andrew Wilson has released the proof text
Host verbal reference to Sheriff Brooksby's statement about a call from Mike Mitchell (not shown)

claims.label: Farnsworth Pocketed SD Card From Camera Behind Charlie's Head Within ~4–5 Minutes of Shooting
claims.claim: The host says that in footage shown the previous day, the camera operator removed an SD card from the camera behind Charlie Kirk's head, looked around, and pocketed it within approximately four to five minutes of Charlie being struck.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain original unedited video and corroborate timestamp via SBI / law-enforcement chain-of-custody records for the SD card in question.

claims.label: Farnsworth Subsequently Inserted That SD Card Into His Laptop
claims.claim: The host describes footage in which the camera operator opens his laptop and appears to insert the previously pocketed SD card into it, which she says, citing a government source, was all within roughly ten minutes of the shooting.
claims.investigative_direction: Recover laptop forensic artifacts (connection logs, file-system events, USB device traces) and compare timing against host's stated "government source" timeline.

claims.label: Farnsworth Stepped Over the Fallen Yellow Camera to Reach the Camera Behind Charlie's Head
claims.claim: The host presents that, when retrieving SD cards, Terryl stepped over the yellow audience-facing camera – which had fallen to the floor – rather than retrieving its SD card.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify whether the yellow camera's SD card was ever collected and, if so, by whom and at what timestamp.

claims.label: The Yellow Audience-Facing Camera Fell to the Floor Approximately When Charlie Was Removed From the Scene
claims.claim: The host presents footage showing the yellow audience-facing camera falling/being knocked down shortly after Charlie Kirk was taken away from the scene.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm camera-down timestamp via SBI/UPD evidence logs and assess whether the fall was accidental or post-removal disturbance.

claims.label: Trump Described a Close Acquaintance Who Recognized Tyler Robinson, Which the Host Says Is Mike Mitchell
claims.claim: In a Fox and Friends appearance aired in the immediate aftermath of Tyler Robinson's arrest, Donald Trump stated that "somebody that's close" - described as a person involved in law enforcement and a minister - recognized Tyler Robinson from a slight tilt of the head, then went to the father and to a US Marshal. The host says he was describing Mike Mitchell.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference Trump's account against official law-enforcement timeline documents (probable-cause affidavit, charging document signed by Brian Davis) and Mitchell's own statements.

claims.label: Mike Mitchell Is Identified in Trump's Account as Both a Person Involved in Law Enforcement and a Person of Faith / Minister
claims.claim: Trump's on-air description characterizes the recognizing individual as a person involved in law enforcement and "a person of faith, a minister," which the host maps to Mike Mitchell's known roles.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Mike Mitchell's documented roles (Mormon minister, prior undercover work in sex crimes, family-friend relationship to Robinsons) via official biographies and law-enforcement employment records.

claims.label: Blake Neff Publicly Asserted the Robinson Defense Does Not Contest Core Evidence
claims.claim: Blake Neff's tweet (read in full) asserts that the Tyler Robinson defense filing is "very conspicuously not contesting any of the core evidence" - specifically camera footage, DNA, the rifle, cause of death, and Robinson's phone data - and that all the defense has is a complaint about reliable hearsay and attacks on the aggravating factors.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the actual defense filing and compare verbatim to Neff's characterization; assess community-note rebuttal text shown in artifact.

claims.label: Hasan Piker Publicly Praised Candace Owens for Undermining Effort to "Martyrize" Charlie Kirk
claims.claim: In an audio clip, streamer Hasan Piker calls Candace Owens "a queen" who "successfully and single-handedly undermined the Republican initiative to martyrize Charlie Kirk," while simultaneously stating his belief that Tyler Robinson likely did it.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the full unedited Piker stream segment and timestamp; cross-check against the Brandi Zadrozny article the host references.

claims.label: Blake Neff Publicly Characterized Candace Owens as a "Gift" to the Radical Left
claims.claim: Blake Neff's tweet (read in full) states that "the radical pro-violence left knows exactly what a gift Candace and her ilk are to them," framing her investigative work on the Robinson case as materially assisting left-wing political interests.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm tweet text against archive (e.g., X/Twitter permanent-link capture) and identify any subsequent correction or community-note action.

claims.label: Host Plays Wear Forbidden Matrix-Parody Video Repeating "So What?" Against Tyler Robinson Case Argumentation Standards
claims.claim: The host plays a clip she says is from the Wear Forbidden account, a short parody video using the Matrix red-pill/blue-pill framing about the Tyler Robinson case, repeating "so what?" in response to "positive evidence," "appeal to emotion," and "burden of proof."
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm the original post URL and capture it before any takedown; identify creator if pseudonymous.

claims.label: Host's Government Source Places All SD Card and Laptop Activity Within ~10 Minutes of Charlie Kirk Being Struck
claims.claim: The host states, citing a government source she trusts, that the entire sequence – Terryl pocketing the SD card, racing to his laptop, and the apparent SD card insertion – occurred within approximately ten minutes of Charlie Kirk being shot.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference host's timeline against SBI / UPD / FBI event-time records and any device-timestamp metadata recoverable from Terryl's laptop.

claims.label: Host Says Blake Neff Is Telling Reporters She Is Just Jealous of Erika
claims.claim: The host says Blake Neff is speaking to reporters and wants everyone to know that she is just jealous of Erika Kirk.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the reporters Neff spoke to and obtain the published or unpublished statements attributed to him.
claims.transcript_snippet: Blake Neff is now entering the fray. Um he's speaking to reporters and wants everyone to know that I'm just jealous of Erika.

claims.label: Host Says TPUSA Is Pushing a Talking Point That She Works in Coordination With Hasan
claims.claim: The host says Turning Point USA figures are now pushing the talking point that she is working in coordination or support of the aims of Hasan, which she says implies Charlie died so the left could be blamed absent positive evidence.
claims.investigative_direction: Collect the TPUSA-side statements and articles that make the Hasan-coordination claim and compare their wording with the Piker clip.
claims.transcript_snippet: They're also now pushing the same talking point that I'm now somehow working in coordination or support of I guess the aims of Hasan

claims.label: Host Says Terryl Lied to Her About Not Knowing How to Send a Clip
claims.claim: The host says that in the previous episode she demonstrated that Terryl lied to her about not knowing how to send a clip and about a fear that Google would hack him.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the host's account of the conversation with Farnsworth with the Google Drive transmission records for the September 10 videos.
claims.transcript_snippet: yesterday I demonstrated to you all that Terryl lied to me. That's just a fact. He lied to me about not knowing how to send a clip.

claims.label: Host Says She Was Told the Footage Is in the Purview of Law Enforcement
claims.claim: The host says that when she asked why the footage was not simply released to clear his name, the person she was speaking with said it was in the purview of law enforcement, and that she finds it difficult to imagine accepting that as a reason not to release or at least leak it.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify who made the statement and ask the SBI and Utah authorities whether any instruction not to release the footage was given.
claims.transcript_snippet: And he said, "That's in the preview of law enforcement." He meant in the purview of law enforcement.

claims.label: Host Says Police Cannot Demand a Phone or Footage Without a Warrant
claims.claim: The host says a police officer cannot simply declare a private person's phone to be in the purview of law enforcement, can ask them to share footage willingly, and cannot demand it without a warrant.
claims.investigative_direction: Check Utah and federal law on compelled production of personal recordings without a warrant and whether any warrant covered the camera operator's devices.
claims.transcript_snippet: They can't demand it without a warrant, right?

claims.label: Host Says Terryl Was the First to Declare Charlie Dead
claims.claim: The host says Terryl is the first one who declared Charlie Kirk dead, and that all of the SD card handling followed within about four minutes.
claims.investigative_direction: Establish from witness statements and video who first pronounced Charlie dead and at what time.
claims.transcript_snippet: Um it's hard to forget that he is the first one who declared Charlie's dead.

claims.label: Host Says She Has Held the Footage Since October and Spoke to Terryl in September
claims.claim: The host says she calls the footage her October surprise because she has had it since October, and that she has been interested in Terryl since September, when she spoke to him and it felt off.
claims.investigative_direction: Establish when and from whom the host obtained the footage and the date of her conversation with Farnsworth.
claims.transcript_snippet: Well, today we can share with you my very own October surprise. I call it an October surprise because I've had it since October.

claims.label: Host Says She Learned He Opened His Laptop Right After Pocketing the Card
claims.claim: The host says there were good guys in government working behind the scenes, and that what she learned is that after pocketing the SD card he pretty immediately opened his laptop.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the government-side source and check the footage timestamp against the laptop opening.
claims.transcript_snippet: And what I learned is that after he pocketed that, he then pretty immediately opened up his laptop.

claims.label: Host Says Lane Schamberger Was Washing His Hands and Had Helped Carry Charlie to the Car
claims.claim: The host says Lane Schamberger is visible on the side washing his hands in the footage, which she says makes sense because he helped carry Charlie Kirk into the car.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm Schamberger's role in carrying Charlie to the vehicle from other video and witness accounts.
claims.transcript_snippet: yes, some people might be noting that Lane Schamberger is on the side washing his hands. That makes sense. Don't think too hard about it. He did help carry Charlie into the car.

claims.label: Host Says the Footage Shows Terryl Texting and Then Sitting Facing the Other Way on His Laptop
claims.claim: The host says Terryl is shown texting with someone, then picks up the laptop and sits facing the other direction, continuing on the laptop for a purpose she says she does not know.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full unedited footage and the phone records identifying who Farnsworth was texting and what was done on the laptop.
claims.transcript_snippet: He picks up the laptop and what happens thereafter is he sits facing the other direction and continues on to his laptop doing what I don't know.

claims.label: Host Says Kolvet Told Them the Cards Were Taken Because People Can Be Evil
claims.claim: The host says Andrew Kolvet told them Terryl was taking the SD cards because people can be evil, and questions why the card then needed to go onto a laptop when it was already secured in his pocket.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate Kolvet's original statement and compare it with Bowyer's different account of why the cards were removed.
claims.transcript_snippet: We were told from Andrew he was doing this because people can be evil.

claims.label: Host Says They Were Told There Was Nothing Special About the Camera Behind Charlie's Head
claims.claim: The host says they were told there was nothing special about the camera behind Charlie's head, and she argues there clearly was.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify who told the host the camera was unremarkable and compare with Farnsworth's and Kolvet's accounts of why it was taken first.
claims.transcript_snippet: we were told that there was nothing special about the camera behind Charlie's head and I would argue that there clearly was.

claims.label: Host Says Terryl's 1102 Statement Describes the Yellow Camera as Filming the Audience
claims.claim: The host says that, according to Terryl's 1102 statement, the yellow camera was filming the audience, in particular the individuals asking questions.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain Farnsworth's statement and check what it says about each camera's assignment and coverage.
claims.transcript_snippet: according to Taral's 1102 statement, we know that that's filming the audience in particular the individuals that are asking questions.

claims.label: Host Says Terryl Took the Head-Camera Card About Three Minutes After the Yellow Camera Fell
claims.claim: The host says Terryl appeared about three minutes after the yellow camera fell to take the SD card from the camera behind Charlie's head, and stepped over the fallen camera and its SD card to do so.
claims.investigative_direction: Time-stamp the camera fall and Farnsworth's arrival in the original footage.
claims.transcript_snippet: So when Taral appears approximately 3 minutes later to take the SD card from behind from the camera behind Charlie's head he steps over it.

claims.label: Host Says TPUSA Is Asking Media Friends to Portray Her as a Digital Assassin
claims.claim: The host says that even though she is seeking only clear answers and not harassment, TPUSA is seeding a narrative and asking media friends to publish articles portraying her as a digital assassin.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the articles and the TPUSA contacts that supplied them to the journalists.
claims.transcript_snippet: even though they are seeding the narrative and asking their media friends to put articles, like we're I'm some digital assassin for sharing the truth

claims.label: Host Says Erika Told Glenn Beck That Charlie Was Not Texting Fears the Night Before
claims.claim: The host says Erika Kirk stated publicly and with confidence on Glenn Beck's show that Charlie was not sending text messages the night before signaling that he was worried he was going to be killed.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the Glenn Beck interview and compare Erika's statement with the night-before messages the host describes.
claims.transcript_snippet: when Erika publicly stated with confidence on Glenn Beck's show that Charlie was not sending text messages the night before signaling that he was worried he was going to be killed

claims.label: Host Says Erika Should Publicly Correct the Glenn Beck Statement
claims.claim: The host says that because the night-before text claim turned out not to be true, it is incumbent on Erika to correct the record publicly, as the show does when it makes honest mistakes.
claims.investigative_direction: Check whether Erika Kirk or TPUSA has issued any correction of the Glenn Beck statement.
claims.transcript_snippet: it then becomes incumbent upon Erika herself to correct the record publicly when we learn that that isn't true.

claims.label: Host Says Neff Repeatedly Misrepresents Court Filings and TPUSA Brings Influencers to Court
claims.claim: The host says TPUSA brings influencers into the courtroom and that Blake Neff has repeatedly misrepresented court filings to the public to assert that Tyler Robinson is guilty, adding that Robinson faces the death sentence.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare each Neff post about a Robinson filing with the filing text and the invitation list for influencers at the hearings.
claims.transcript_snippet: Why are they bringing influencers into the courtroom? Why are they, as Blake Neff has done repeatedly, completely misrepresenting court filings to the public in order to do just that?

claims.label: Host Says Neff's Tweet Was Community Noted for Intentional Misrepresentation
claims.claim: The host says the Blake Neff tweet from that morning has already been community noted for intentional misrepresentation.
claims.investigative_direction: Capture the tweet and its Community Note with timestamps before any edit or removal.
claims.transcript_snippet: He's already been community noted on it for its intentional misrepresentation.

claims.label: Host Reads the Community Note: Preliminary Hearings Decide Only Probable Cause
claims.claim: The host reads the Community Note, which says preliminary hearings decide only probable cause, reliable hearsay is allowed under the Utah 1102 standard, and defense counsel often skip alternative theories to avoid previewing strategy, so silence does not prove they lack merit.
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve the full Community Note text and compare it with Utah Rule 1102 and the defense filing.
claims.transcript_snippet: it says preliminary hearings decide only probable cause. Under the Utah 1102 standard, um uh reliable hearsay is allowed. Defense counsel often skip alternative theories to avoid previewing their strategy before the trial.

claims.label: Neff's Tweet Asks Why the Defense Did Not Raise Candace's Theories
claims.claim: The Neff tweet as read says that if there was any merit to the theories Candace and others have pushed for the last 11 months, the defense would have brought them up.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the prosecution response and the defense filing to see which theories, if any, each addresses.
claims.transcript_snippet: If there was any merit at all to any of the theories that Candace and them have pushed the last 11 months, why didn't the defense bring them up?

claims.label: Host Explains Preliminary Hearings Test Whether the Filing Is Defective, Not Guilt
claims.claim: The host says preliminary hearings are not about discovering guilt or innocence but about arguing whether the filing itself is defective, and that Neff is banking on the public not knowing how legal filings work.
claims.investigative_direction: Check Utah criminal procedure on the purpose and standard of a preliminary hearing against the host's description.
claims.transcript_snippet: Yes, preliminary hearings are not about discovering guilt or innocence. It is about arguing whether or not the filing itself is defective, okay?

claims.label: Host Says Lively Sued With 13 Causes of Action and 10 Were Dismissed
claims.claim: The host says Blake Lively initially sued Justin Baldoni with 13 causes of action and the court decided that 10 of them were inactionable and dismissed them before trial.
claims.investigative_direction: Check the court order on Baldoni's motion to dismiss for the number of claims dismissed.
claims.transcript_snippet: And the court came back and decided, "Actually, yes, Justin, you're you're correct that 10 of these causes of action are inactionable.

claims.label: Host Says She Filed a Dismissal Against Brian Harpole's Lawsuit
claims.claim: The host says Brian Harpole filed a lawsuit carrying a long series of claims and that she filed a dismissal motion because some of the claims are ridiculous.
claims.investigative_direction: Pull the Harpole complaint and the host's motion to dismiss from the court docket.
claims.transcript_snippet: Same with me and Brian Harpole. There's another example. Again, these are civil examples. He filed a lawsuit.

claims.label: Host Says Harpole Is Suing Her for Calling His Shawn Ryan Interview Unconvincing
claims.claim: The host says one of the things Harpole is suing her over is her saying she found his interview with Shawn Ryan unconvincing, which she argues is protected opinion.
claims.investigative_direction: Check the complaint for the Shawn Ryan interview claim and the host's opinion-is-protected-speech argument.
claims.transcript_snippet: So, he's suing me for saying I found his interview with Shawn Ryan to be unconvincing.

claims.label: Host Says Her Macron Dismissal Argues Macron Should Not Be in That Court
claims.claim: The host says her dismissal filing in the Brigitte Macron matter argues that Macron is not supposed to be in that court, noting that Macron is in France but suing in Delaware while she is in Tennessee.
claims.investigative_direction: Read the motion to dismiss in the Delaware case for the jurisdiction and venue grounds.
claims.transcript_snippet: That's what I'm arguing. She's not even supposed to be here. What are we even talking about? She's in Delaware. I'm in Tennessee.

claims.label: Host Says TPUSA Has Treated Robinson as Guilty Since Erika Forgave Him on Stage
claims.claim: The host says the position that the evidence is overwhelming and Tyler Robinson is guilty has been expressed by Turning Point USA since the moment Erika forgave Tyler Robinson on the stage.
claims.investigative_direction: Compile TPUSA and Erika Kirk public statements about Robinson's guilt after the memorial.
claims.transcript_snippet: since the moment Erika forgave Tyler Robinson on the stage.

claims.investigative_direction: Review the host's prior episodes and the debate transcript for any explicit accusation of this kind.

claims.investigative_direction: Identify the journalists and articles carrying this framing and any TPUSA contact with them.

claims.label: Host Says Erika Is Complicit in Seeding the Narrative That Robinson Was Guilty
claims.claim: The host says she thinks Erika is wrong, that what she has done to the organization is abysmal, and that she is certainly complicit in helping seed the narrative that Tyler Robinson was guilty before the preliminary hearing.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare Erika Kirk's public statements on Robinson with the timing of the hearing.
claims.transcript_snippet: she is uh certainly complicit in helping to seed the narrative that Tommy Robinson is guilty or was guilty before we even got to the probative hearing.

claims.label: Host Says She Called the Vice President Complicit for Speaking About Robinson at TPUSA
claims.claim: The host says she also said the vice president was complicit when he was on stage at Turning Point USA talking about Tyler Robinson, asking how that does not sway the jury.
claims.investigative_direction: Review the vice president's remarks at the TPUSA event for what he said about Robinson.
claims.transcript_snippet: The vice president I also said was complicit in that when he was on stage at Turning Point USA talking about Tommy Robinson.

claims.label: Host Says No Proof Has Been Produced That Robinson's Parents Turned Him In
claims.claim: The host says TPUSA-side voices have not produced any proof that Tyler Robinson's parents turned him in or thought he was guilty, and that she tried to explain to Andrew Wilson where he got the idea.
claims.investigative_direction: Find the primary source for the claim that the parents turned Robinson in and check it against the probable-cause documents.
claims.transcript_snippet: They have not produced any proof of that, and I tried and made a great effort to explain to Andrew Wilson where he got that from.

claims.label: Host Says the Charging Document Does Not Show Whether the Hearsay Came From Mike Mitchell
claims.claim: The host says that from the charging document, which seems to be the basis for the rumors, it cannot be told whether the reliable hearsay came from Mike Mitchell, whom she describes as quarterbacking everything against Tyler Robinson.
